$comment: Contract for data/tables/sources.csv. Checked by build/src/schema.js.
title: Sources
description: One row per source document or page, with its retrieval record and SHA-256.

fields.name: SourceID
fields.description: Stable source identifier, never reused. The prefix says where it came from, and the rest names the document: B Bambu Lab, S Polymaker, X and XP 3DXTECH, I iSANMATE, PR Prusa Research, D other manufacturers' pages, R a reference or web datasheet, CA a Canadian retailer, P a paper, H2C the printer's own documentation, NIOSH and other bodies their own name, LOCAL a user-supplied reference. Keep a publisher's existing prefix rather than inventing a second one for it.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: The document's own title as the publisher printed it: a sheet's heading, a page's title or main heading. Never a file name, a shop page's payment or store chrome, or a placeholder such as untitled (D63; lint SOURCE-TITLE-NOT-TITLE).

fields.name: Publication date
fields.description: Publication date (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD) or Not published.

fields.name: Source class
fields.description: What kind of document it is. A fact about this one document goes in Source note, not in the class.

fields.name: Source note
fields.description: What is particular about this document: where it is hosted, what it covers, why it is kept. Not applicable where the class says it all.

fields.name: Citation role
fields.description: Why the source is registered: cited by records, or kept to corroborate, to register scope or prices, as provenance, or recorded as not retrieved.

fields.name: URL
fields.description: URL, or local path for a local reference.

fields.name: Applicable grades
fields.description: Grades or scope the source applies to, in words. Every grade ID it mentions must exist.

fields.name: Access state
fields.description: How it was reached: retrieved, retrieved-copy, read-only or not-retrieved. Nothing may cite a source that was not retrieved.

fields.name: Access note
fields.description: What else the retrieval record says, in the words it was written in: which copy was read, how it was checked, why it could not be reached. Not applicable where the state says it all.
